items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] At the Bell Tavern, was that C. L. Burke? [INTERVIEWER] Yes, C.L. Burke was there, yes, C. L. Burke had the Bell Tavern.

ctx.x: I didn't pay any attention to him. Well, the only one that I know of of these band leaders that was a good one, and that one is -- you know, it's kind of hard to think of some of this.
Yeah, right. It wasn't C. L. Burke, was it?
